protocol.scope: Budget-limited replication of donor-intervention predictive coverage on quantized checkpoints. Differences between models also include quantization. The identity-prior ridge member of ILS is fixed before measurement. This is not the original full ILS estimator search.
protocol.data: WikiText-103 raw v1. Random distinct training rows for training and test-split rows for testing. Separate donors per source. Same text rows and positions for both models.
protocol.metrics: Held-out pooled residual R2, paired differences with 2000 prompt bootstrap draws. Report all cells. Last block is an analytic control. Five-fold fitting-prompt CV on identical training data. Check whether pre-final coverage rises with depth and falls with horizon; no fitted onset or universal threshold.
